item.text:
# Abdel Fattah el-Sisi in 2024: initial evidence note

I stopped searching after 6 web calls and kept this to primary or highly credible sources. I separated 2024 events from background context.

| Scope | Valence | Accepted claim | Source | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Background | Neutral / negative | Egypt entered 2024 under severe macroeconomic strain, with the IMF saying the 2023 return to a fixed exchange rate had damaged credibility, contributed to FX shortages, widened the parallel market spread, constrained imports, and fueled inflation. | [Arab Republic of Egypt: First and Second Reviews Under the Extended Arrangement Under the Extended Fund Facility...](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/04/26/arab-republic-of-egypt-first-and-second-reviews-under-the-extended-arrangement-under-the-548335) - IMF, Apr 26, 2024 | This is background context for the term: the 2024 presidency began amid a hard economic adjustment environment, not a clean slate. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| Background | Negative | Human Rights Watch’s 2024 Egypt country page described a long-running severe human-rights crisis under Sisi, including mass detention, torture, disappearances, and sharply curtailed civic space. | [Egypt | Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/es/middle-east/n-africa/egypt) - HRW, Sep 16, 2024 | This is background context, not a single 2024 event, but it frames the political environment around Sisi’s 2024 term. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Positive / institutional | On April 2, 2024, Sisi took the constitutional oath for a new presidential term at the House of Representatives in the New Administrative Capital. | [President El-Sisi Takes the Constitutional Oath for a New Presidential Term](https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/1-news-242024/) - Presidency of the Republic of Egypt, Apr 2, 2024 | Confirms the formal start of the 2024 term and continuity of rule. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Positive / diplomatic | On March 17, 2024, the EU and Egypt signed a Strategic and Comprehensive Partnership; the EU called Egypt a reliable partner with a vital geo-strategic role in the region. | [Joint Declaration on the Strategic and Comprehensive Partnership between The Arab Republic Of Egypt and the European Union](https://north-africa-middle-east-gulf.ec.europa.eu/news/joint-declaration-strategic-and-comprehensive-partnership-between-arab-republic-egypt-and-european-2024-03-17_en) - European Commission, Mar 17, 2024 | Evidence that Sisi’s term had significant external support and regional standing early in 2024. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Positive / economic management | On March 29, 2024, the IMF completed the first and second reviews of Egypt’s EFF arrangement and approved an augmentation of about USD 5 billion, tied to a flexible exchange-rate regime, tighter fiscal and monetary policy, and reduced public investment. | [IMF Executive Board Completes the First and Second Reviews of Extended Fund Facility Arrangement for Egypt, Approves Augmentation of the Arrangement](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/03/29/pr24101-egypt-imf-executive-board-completes-first-second-reviews-eff-approves-augmentation) - IMF, Mar 29, 2024 | Strong evidence that Sisi’s team was pursuing externally backed stabilization and that macro policy was a defining feature of the year. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Positive / foreign policy | On June 11, 2024, Sisi co-chaired a Gaza humanitarian-response conference with Jordan’s king and the UN secretary-general, calling for an immediate permanent ceasefire and expanded humanitarian access. | [“Call for Action: Urgent Humanitarian Response for Gaza” Statement by co-chairs King Abdullah II of Jordan, President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi of Egypt, and UN Secretary-General António Guterres](https://www.un.org/unispal/document/statement-by-co-chairs-urgent-humanitarian-response-for-gaza-11jun24/) - United Nations, Jun 11, 2024 | Shows Sisi as a central regional diplomat in 2024, especially on Gaza and cross-border humanitarian access. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Mixed | On July 3, 2024, Sisi oversaw the swearing-in of a new cabinet headed by Moustafa Madbouly. | [President El-Sisi Witnesses the Swearing-in of the New Cabinet](https://www.presidency.eg/en/%D9%82%D8%B3%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1/%D8%A3%D8%AE%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D8%A7%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A9/news372024/) - Presidency of the Republic of Egypt, Jul 3, 2024 | Signals an administrative reset inside the term; useful as governance context for the year. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Negative | Amnesty International said on May 13, 2024 that Egyptian authorities had intensified arrests and detention of protesters, striking workers, and people criticizing the economic crisis online. | [Egypt: Halt crackdown on people voicing concerns over economic crisis](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/) - Amnesty International, May 13, 2024 | Strong evidence of repression tied to economic discontent during the year. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Negative | Amnesty International said on July 18, 2024 that Egyptian authorities had arbitrarily detained 119 people in connection with online calls for anti-government protests over price hikes and power cuts. | [Egypt: More than 100 arbitrarily detained over calls for anti-government protests](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/) - Amnesty International, Jul 18, 2024 | Concrete evidence that public dissatisfaction with living conditions triggered further crackdowns in Sisi’s 2024 term. | n/a in this isolated pass |
| 2024 event | Positive / mixed | On July 29, 2024, the IMF said Egypt’s stabilization efforts had started to yield positive results and that inflation was coming down, even though conditions remained difficult. | [IMF Executive Board Completes the Third Review of the Extended Arrangement under the Extended Fund Facility for Egypt](https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24293-egypt-imf-exec-board-completes-3rd-rev-extended-arr-eff) - IMF, Jul 29, 2024 | Best single-source evidence that the 2024 economic story was not only crisis but also partial stabilization progress. | n/a in this isolated pass |
